functions.name: PopAudio
functions.signature: PopAudio(Target, Out Buffer, Num Samples, Use Latest Audio)
functions.docs: Copies the minimum of NumSamples or however many samples are available into OutBuffer. Returns the number of samples copied, or -1 if this output's corresponding input has been destroyed.

functions.name: MixInAudio
functions.signature: MixInAudio(Target, Out Buffer, Num Samples, Use Latest Audio)
functions.docs: Sums the minimum of NumSamples or however many samples are available into OutBuffer. Returns the number of samples summed into OutBuffer.

functions.name: GetNumSamplesAvailable
functions.docs: Returns the current number of samples buffered on this output.

functions.name: WaitUntilNumSamplesAvailable
functions.signature: WaitUntilNumSamplesAvailable(Target, Num Samples, Time Out Milliseconds)
functions.docs: Pauses the current thread until there are the given number of samples available to pop. Will return true if it succeeded, false if it timed out.

functions.name: IsInputStale
functions.docs: Returns true if the input for this patch has been destroyed.

functions.name: PushAudio
functions.docs:
Pushes audio from InBuffer to the corresponding FPatchOutput.
Pushes zeros if InBuffer is nullptr.
Returns how many samples were able to be pushed, or -1 if the output was disconnected.

functions.name: ClearAudio
functions.docs: Clears any audio queued up in the patch.

functions.name: IsOutputStillActive
functions.docs: Returns false if this output was removed, either because someone called FPatchMixer::RemoveTap with this FPatchInput, or the FPatchMixer was destroyed.

functions.name: IsValid
functions.docs: Returns false if this output was not initialized properly.

functions.name: AddNewInput
functions.docs: Adds an existing patch input to the patch mixer.

functions.name: RemovePatch
functions.docs: Removes a tap from the tap collector. Calling this is thread safe, though FPatchOutput will likely not be deleted until the next call of PopAudio.

functions.name: PopAudio
functions.signature: PopAudio(Target, Out Buffer, Out Num Samples, Use Latest Audio)
functions.docs: Mixes all inputs into a single buffer. This should only be called from a single thread. Returns the number of non-silent samples popped to OutBuffer.

functions.name: Num
functions.docs: This returns the number of inputs currently connected to this patch mixer. Thread safe, but blocks for PopAudio.

functions.name: MaxNumberOfSamplesThatCanBePopped
functions.docs: This function call gets the maximum number of samples that's safe to pop, based on the thread with the least amount of samples buffered. Thread safe, but blocks for PopAudio.

functions.name: DisconnectAllInputs
functions.docs: Disconnect everything currently connected to this mixer.

functions.name: AddNewPatch
functions.signature: AddNewPatch(Target, In Patch Output Strong Ptr)
functions.docs: Adds a new a patch from an existing patch output.

functions.name: PushAudio
functions.signature: PushAudio(Target, In Buffer, In Num Samples)
functions.docs: This call pushes audio to all outputs connected to this splitter. Only should be called from one thread.

functions.name: MaxNumberOfSamplesThatCanBePushed
functions.docs: This function call gets the maximum number of samples that's safe to push. Thread safe, but blocks for PushAudio.

functions.name: AddNewOutput
functions.signature: AddNewOutput(Target, In Patch Output Strong Ptr)
functions.docs: Adds a new a patch from an existing patch output.

functions.name: AddNewInput
functions.signature: AddNewInput(Target, Max Latency In Samples, In Gain)
functions.docs: Strong pointer to our destination buffer.

functions.name: AddNewInput
functions.docs: Adds a new a patch input from an existing patch input object.

functions.name: RemovePatch
functions.docs: Removes a tap from the tap collector. Calling this is thread safe, though FPatchOutput will likely not be deleted until the next call of PopAudio.

functions.name: ProcessAudio
functions.docs: Mixes audio from all inputs and pushes it to all outputs. Should be called regularly.
